data.narrative:
Span is a Series C-stage climate and energy company that has raised approximately $419M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of three same-sector, same-stage private companies (KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Amogy) alongside one public comparable (Lemonade, ticker LNZA), representing the frontier-tech energy subsector where comparable data remains sparse.

Two triangulation methods were applied. The stage-progression method applies a typical 1.7x step-up multiplier from Series C forward, yielding $712M. The peer-median method anchors to the median valuation of three direct comparables at $1.0B, with a range spanning $700M to $3.0B, reflecting significant dispersion in the peer set. These methods imply a low bound of $605M, a median of $856M, and a high bound of $1.1B.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $605M to $1.1B, with a midpoint of approximately $856M. Key uncertainties include the substantial spread in peer valuations—particularly the $3.0B outlier (KoBold Metals)—and the limited depth of comparables in this nascent sector. Stage-progression and peer-median methods diverge by roughly 40%, suggesting that capital raised alone is insufficient to narrow the range without additional clarity on unit economics and technology maturity relative to peers.
